# Third-party notices

## JYao-Chen/cnki-metadata-exporter

- Upstream: https://github.com/JYao-Chen/cnki-metadata-exporter
- Pinned version: `0.2.0`
- Pinned commit: `4bdf8e108c81c4d1a0590377aec1238f534e1a18`
- License: MIT

This project bundles a fixed source archive and a wheel of that pinned version so the tested CNKI export path is not silently changed by upstream updates. The original license is preserved in `third_party/cnki-metadata-exporter.LICENSE.txt`.

The bundled component is used for CNKI native XLS export, checkpoint/resume, merge and deduplication.
